name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
summary: At Grimtotem Post, Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem force that sacked Makaba Flathoof's home. After you strike down the ruffians and mercenaries, Makaba sends you after Grundig and his brutes.

sections.title: The Butcher of the Path
sections.body: Makaba Flathoof survived the assault on his settlement along the Stonetalon trail, but his grief is still raw. After you prove yourself against Grimtotem foot soldiers, he points you toward Grundig Darkcloud, the one behind the bloodshed. Grundig commands a devoted band of brutes and led the slaughter that leveled the village.

sections.title: Strike at Grimtotem Post
sections.body: Grundig camps at Grimtotem Post, farther up the mountain road to the west. To avenge Makaba's kin and protect the pass from more violence, you climb to the stronghold, fight through Grundig's brutes, and kill him before his raiders can descend on other vulnerable camps.

faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud is a Grimtotem commander at Grimtotem Post in southeastern Stonetalon Mountains. He led the attack that destroyed Makaba Flathoof's village.

faq.q: Where can Grundig Darkcloud be found?
faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud is at Grimtotem Post, up the mountain trail to the west of Makaba Flathoof's camp near the Barrens border.

faq.q: What is Makaba Flathoof's motive for this task?
faq.answer: Makaba Flathoof saw the Grimtotem slaughter his home and clanmates. After you strike down their ruffians and mercenaries, he asks you to kill their leader, Grundig Darkcloud, for retribution.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem attacking peaceful settlements here?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem despise other tauren tribes, especially those allied with the Horde or following gentler paths. They use ambushes and raids to drive rival clans from lands they want to control.

faq.q: What comes after killing Grundig Darkcloud?
faq.answer: After you kill Grundig Darkcloud and his brutes, Makaba Flathoof's vengeance is complete. Makaba can mourn his village knowing justice has been served.

faq.q: What is the prerequisite quest for this task?
faq.answer: First, complete Avenge My Village, where Makaba Flathoof tests your resolve by sending you against the Grimtotem ruffians and mercenaries camped just to the west.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see how Grundig's slaughter deepens the discord among your people. The Grimtotem oppose unity under the Horde with cutthroat force.
As a member of the Horde, you know Stonetalon matters to your advance into Kalimdor. Warlords like Grundig threaten the supply routes between the Barrens and Sun Rock Retreat.
